title: 科技之外：多元配置如何穿越波动？，哪些被忽视板块能补位？
speaker: Christina Woon

segments.en: I think touching on that is also a really important point because a lot of the investor's minds focus lies in tech, but you can't possibly put all of your eggs in one basket.
segments.zh: 我认为这一点也很重要，因为很多投资者关注科技，但你不能把所有的鸡蛋放在一个篮子里。

segments.en: So for me, even though having tech as a higher-conviction part of our strategies is important, I think what the last month has really shown us or has really come through is the important of diversification.
segments.zh: 对我来说，虽然科技是我们策略中高确信度的部分，但过去一个月真正显示出来的是多元配置的重要性。

segments.en: So materials, for example, or industrials, have been great areas to find truffles in. These tend to be, I suppose, less efficient sectors, just because people don't look at them as much, but I mean, there are quite a number of good drivers within there that could be positive as well.
segments.zh: 例如，原材料或工业领域是寻找机会的好地方。这些行业往往效率较低，因为关注的人不多，但其中也有不少积极的驱动因素。

segments.en: I mean, if you're like AI, for example, many of the power names within industrials play into that, but perhaps don't get as much attention as the tech sector.
segments.zh: 比如在人工智能领域，工业中的许多电力相关标的也参与其中，但可能没有科技板块那么受关注。

segments.en: Within materials, we saw quite a big sell-off as well, well, actually for the most part of this year, looking at evaluations within that space and given the tightening and demand and supply as well, going into the second half of this year, actually the setup looked pretty good too.
segments.zh: 在原材料领域，今年大部分时间也出现了较大调整，但考虑到估值以及供需收紧，进入下半年，该板块的布局看起来相当不错。

segments.en: So I think being able to position in different areas as well can help you write through some of these short-term sell-offs within tech.
segments.zh: 所以我认为在不同领域进行配置，有助于你度过科技板块的一些短期调整。
